source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES passes both comma-separated labels as one quoted sensor name and truncates fallback output; it omits separate identities, physical inlet/socket/airflow mapping, UI/spec/freshness and safe Script review.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires separate queries, board/socket mapping and independent UI/spec evidence.

old_problem: The two source names were converted into one likely invalid command operand. No evidence separated CPU0_IN from CPU1_IN or mapped either motherboard inlet sensing point to physical socket/airflow, and CPU package readings, similarity, partial SDR output or one row could be falsely accepted for both.
disposition_reason: The source unambiguously names two read-only sensors. Resolve and query them independently, bind each stable record and UI row to its physical motherboard inlet and CPU airflow path, record passive fan/load/ambient state and compare each applicable value/threshold/status/freshness field with its own specification. Exact topology and values are Project inputs; one inlet or CPU package telemetry never substitutes for the other.
decision_basis: XLSX row 875, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
A quoted comma-separated operand is not evidence for two ipmitool sensor records; each identity needs its own command status and evidence.
Motherboard inlet air and CPU die/package temperature are different measurands, and similar temperatures do not prove correct location/identity.
ED-13 governs absent-path N/A, ED-15 requires per-inlet criteria, ED-17 rejects clearing and ED-20 preserves both named sensors independently.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP_MB_CPU0_IN and TEMP_MB_CPU1_IN independently against board airflow mapping and specification
test_case.purpose: Verify the two distinct motherboard CPU-inlet temperature sensors are each human readable in Dashboard and Server Health and independently have the correct physical inlet/socket-airflow identity, Celsius reading, units, health, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness for the platform specification at the recorded passive operating state.
required_package: Exact chassis/board/BMC/BIOS/CPU population and airflow topology with physical CPU0_IN/CPU1_IN locations and socket association
Separate stable SDR/API name/number/type/entity/instance and Dashboard/Server Health row for each inlet
Per-inlet Celsius scaling/rounding, tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health and unavailable rules
Recorded reference ambient location, fan mode/speeds, CPU load/power state, timestamp alignment and update lag/delta
Pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, add CPU/thermal load, obstruct airflow, change fans or write thresholds. Establish a two-row physical inlet/socket/airflow expectation matrix. Enumerate the complete sensor repository and resolve `TEMP_MB_CPU0_IN` and `TEMP_MB_CPU1_IN` separately; never pass the comma-separated pair as one sensor name. Review the Script before use. Capture for each inlet its separate command status, stable identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus its matching Dashboard and Server Health rows. Compare each independently with its specification and approved time-aligned ambient/reference under the recorded passive fan/load state. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent identities.
test_case.expected_result: Two distinct stable sensors and UI rows map to the correct CPU0 and CPU1 motherboard inlet airflow paths. Each complete OOB/UI record independently matches its per-inlet value/unit/threshold/status/freshness specification within approved tolerance and operating context. An absent unpopulated path is N/A only with configuration proof. CPU package or other-inlet data never substitutes, and no state is mutated.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the CPU population/airflow map and separate complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement for both applicable inlet sensors with engineer verdict. One comma operand, one inlet, CPU package telemetry, similar values, truncated output or label-only matching cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate identity, unjustified N/A, stale/out-of-tolerance value or required threshold/status mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; dynamic response is not covered.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL/system logs; thermal/fan/CPU history is relevant context.
Do not query the comma-separated pair as one name; preserve two independent results and statuses.
Do not confuse inlet air with CPU die/package telemetry or infer identity from value similarity.
Do not add stress, alter airflow/fans or write thresholds.
Use threshold capability masks; N/A requires population/capability/spec proof and missing required fields fail.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/board/BMC/BIOS, CPU population and physical CPU0_IN/CPU1_IN sensing-point/airflow/socket map
Two separate complete raw identities, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamps
Separate Dashboard and Server Health evidence for each inlet
Per-inlet spec plus ambient, fan mode/speed, CPU load/power and tolerance/update-lag comparison
Missing/absent/duplicate/swapped/stale disposition and pinned Script/alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-write/no-stress/no-retry proof, final health and per-inlet engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On mapping ambiguity, stale/mismatched values or unexpected health change, stop and preserve both sensors' first evidence; use approved BMC/board topology diagnostics without load or settings changes. Isolate any mutating Script and restore only through the authorized owner.
